result.summary: Исправил требование REQ-102 по замечаниям ворот F1-F9. Главное: я перечислил все формы секретов, которые прятал старый маскировщик (ключи с префиксом, закрытый ключ, пароль в адресе, Authorization и Bearer, пары password=, token=, api_key= и им подобные), и для каждой дал пример отказа и пример «хранится как есть» (имя с выражением, например { token: data.token, user: x }, хранится), а фразу «защита не слабеет» заменил точным списком того, что не покрыто. Проверка линейного времени теперь меряет входы без секретов с нижней границей замера и проверкой, что просматривается весь вход; остальные замечания (счёт, предел запроса, заглушки, число запусков, число тестов, цитаты решений 0017 и 0035, путь scripted) закрыты в тексте и критериях. Остались вопросы к вам и ORCH: какие сужения старой защиты принять (открытые блоки сертификатов, короткие значения без цифры, фразы-пароли) и считать ли приемлемым отказ на фиктивных паролях в тестах агента.

issues.text: For ORCH and the owner (Q12, decisions/0102 item 14 left the border to the analyst, but two points go beyond "only M7 and M10 are not carried over"): (a) public PEM blocks (CERTIFICATE, PUBLIC KEY, CERTIFICATE REQUEST, ...) and a bare "-----BEGIN" without a full header are no longer treated as secrets, because AC0.3 sample O7 and Sai own code (mask.js) require them to be stored; the old rule M1 hid them; (b) unquoted name=value values shorter than 8 characters or without a digit, quoted values with a space or non-ASCII characters, passwords equal to the user name in an address and the 26 placeholder words are not refused; the old M2/M3/M9 hid them. All are listed as residual risk (1)-(5) of the description and the record required by criterion 11(b) must close them with a decision. Proposal: accept (a) and (b) as written (the alternative, refusing them, breaks ordinary code such as token: string, lockfiles, certificates in fixtures); record the choice in a new decisions/ file together with the list of forms F1-F9, or tell me to tighten any point and I rework by your list.

Cost of the chosen border (F5): a quoted literal such as password: "wrong-password" in a test written by an agent is refused and the whole task attempt fails without retry (criteria 5 and 6); the old code masked it instead (and corrupted the file). Options: (A, written) keep, the refusal text tells the agent to take the value from the environment or to use a word from the placeholder list; (B) add a few more test words to the list (for example test-password, wrong-password); (C) refuse only values of 8 or more characters. I wrote A because the list is closed by decisions/0102 item 14 and an extension needs your word; please choose, the criterion text then follows.

Found beyond the list of remarks (AP-019), handled only inside F9: the same per-file acceptance without a secret pre-check exists in the non-claude-cli branch of runner.js acceptResult (scripted outputs), not only in single-run.js importOutputs. I named both in the explicit exclusion and criterion 5(в) tests the run-task path; I did not require all-or-nothing there. If ORCH wants the pre-check for scripted too, it is a one-line change of criterion 5(б) and the exclusion.

For CODE-DESIGNER: (a) the definitions Л1-Л3 and the forms are a contract by samples; the details may be refined by the design if every sample of groups О and С keeps its outcome, the sketch <scratch>/proto.mjs gives 84/84 and can be used as a starting oracle (it is not linear-time). (b) The timing test of criterion 7 runs 9 families x 3 sizes x 7 samples with k calls each; I did not measure its running time, the design should keep it to tens of seconds. (c) The refusal detail for the secret must be distinct from the constant REFUSED text pinned by EX-42 and must be the same on the claude-cli and scripted branches. (d) criterion 3 grep for baits was widened to sk_live_ and "Basic <base64>" patterns, so the new test file must build those samples from parts.
